s: Dinim hannohagim tekep achar habbediqa ubo t"z seipim: keshebbodeq adam umechappes achar hechametz belel y"d, motzio min hachorim umin hassedaqim umin hammachaboot umin hazzaviyyot, umeqabbetz hakkol umannicho bemaqom echad, veeno mebaaro miyyad, ella tzarik lehamtin ad lemachar besop shaa chamishit, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tm"h. Vetzarik hu lehizzaher bo leshomro shello yitgarer mimmennu meuma al yede qetannim o akbarim, veyitztarek lachazor velibdoq paam acheret kesheyyitbarer lo sheggareru mimmennu, kegon shello yimtza kol kak chatikot keminyan chatikot shehaya bo beshaa shehinnichan sham miyyad achar habbediqa, ubevadday nechsar mimmennu al yede tinoqot o akbarim sheggareru mimmennu, veyesh lachosh shemma hinnichuhu beechad mechore habbayit, ulekak tzarik lachazor ulebodqo paam acheret veshemma yishkach, o shemma lo yihyeh baqi bahalaka sheeno yodea shetztzarik hu lachazor velibdoq, lepikak hittilu chakamim al kol ish sheyyizzaher bechametz shemmatza babbediqa sheyyishmerennu yapeh mippene hattinoqot vehaakbarim. Veketzad yishmerennu mippenehem? Matznio beteba vekayyotze bah maqom sheen hattinoqot veakbarim yekolin littol mishsham, o yitlennu baavir, o yikpeh alayv keli rachab veyannichennu bemaqom gaboah qetzat shello yukelu hattinoqot littelo mishsham. Velo yikpeh alayv keli qatan vetzar, mippene shehaakbarim yekolin legalloto:

Veken hechametz hammukan umunnach babbayit o bishar chadarim hatztzerikim bediqa leekol mimmenna ballayla ulemachar ad shaa chamishit, tzarik hu lehatznia kederek shennitbaer. Veematay matznio? Qodem sheyyatchil libdoq, sheim lo yatznia miqqodem — yesh lachosh shebbishat habbediqa atzmah, keshebbadaq zavit achat veholek mimmenna lezavit acheret, shemma yireh beenayv sheakbar o chulda notla meat chametz min hechametz hammukan laakila, veyitztarek lachazor velibdoq paam acheret otah zavit shebbadaq, shemma gareru et hechametz shennatelu vehinnichu bezavit zo. Umittaam zeh tzarik lehizzaher kesheholek libdoq mizzavit lezavit, sheyyishmor yapeh et hechametz shemmatza bazzavit harishona, veyolikennu immo o yatznio kederek shennitbaer:

Vehaolam en nizharin ella lehatznia hechametz shemmotzein babbediqa, abal shear hechametz molikin aneh vaana betok hachadarim habbeduqim, veenan nizharim bo leshomro shello yitgarer mimmennu meuma, velo yapeh hem osim, vetzarik lelammedam ulehazhiram shello yaasu ken:

Im hitznia et hechametz kederek shennitbaer veachar kak metzao chaser, o shennittal legamre — en tzarik lachazor velibdoq mah shebbadaq kebar, shebbevadday adam netalo mishsham velo tinoqot veakbarim:

Veim abar velo hitznio kelal, ella hinnicho mepuzzar umeporad betok habbayit, velo nizhar leshomro kelal, vegam eno yodea minyan hachatikot shehaya bo, veepshar shennechsar mimmennu kamma chatikot ugerarum hattinoqot vehaakbarim — ap al pi ken en tzarik lachazor velibdoq paam acheret, dekevan sheen barur lo shennechsar mimmennu en anu matzrikin oto lachazor velibdoq mah shebbadaq kebar bishbil chashasha beolma shemma gareru haakbarim min hechametz (perush chatika gedola, sheen haakbar yakol leoklah kullah, abal im haya gorer chatika qetanna hayinu tolin lomar sheakalah kullah, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g, shessepeq akila motzi mide sepeq chametz, ayyen sham) vehinnichuhu beechad mechore habbayit, sheim natzrikuhu lachazor velibdoq bishbil chashasha kazo — en laddabar sop, shei epshar sheyyigmeru kol yisrael et bediqat chemtzam berega echad, ukesheechad gamar bediqato qodem sheggamar chabero libdoq et kol chadarayv — yesh lachosh shemma berega zo natal haakbar chametz mechadarim shel chabero sheenan beduqin adayin veyesh bahen chametz larob, vegarar et hechametz veholiko lachadarim habbeduqim shel zeh sheggamar bediqato, veyitztarek lachazor velibdoq, veen laddabar sop:

Veachar habbediqa miyyad yebattel kol chametz sheyyesh bekol gebulo shello metzao babbediqa. Ubittul zeh taqqanat chakamim hi. Velamma tiqqenuhu chakamim, vahalo ap im nisharu kamma perurim chametz bezaviyyot ubechorim ubisdaqim shello metzaam babbediqa hare hem betelim mealehem, veen tzarik lebattelam ulehapqiram, shemmealehem hem hepqer, shehare enam chashubim kelal beene bene adam, veap im haya motze otam bibdiqato lo haya notelam veokelam, ella haya mashlikam limqom hepqer o sorepam, veim ken lamma tiqqenuhu chakamim bittul zeh? Ella lepi shechasheshu shemma nishara gelusqa yapa shel chametz beechad min hazzaviyyot o beechad min hachorim shello metzaah babbediqa, veillu haya motzeah hayeta chashuba beenayv velo haya mapqirah, ulekak enah betela meeleha kemo perurin, veyesh lachosh shemma yimtzaenna bepesach veyaabor aleha be"bal yeraeh" ub"bal yimmatze". (Abal qodem shemmetzaah eno ober be"bal yimmatze" ap al pi shehayeta temuna bebeto, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g, ayyen sham hattaam). Veap al pi shemmiyyad sheyyimtzaenna yebaarenna min haolam legamre? Yesh lachosh shemma yishheh meat qodem sheyyitasseq bebiur, veal shehiyya zo ober be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Abal keshebbittel kol chametz shello metzao babbediqa, ap im yimtza gelusqa bappesach velo yebaarenna miyyad — lo yaabor aleha be"bal yeraeh" min hattora, ella middibre soperim:

Veiqqar habbittul hu balleb, sheyyasim belibbo kol chametz shebbirshuto hare hu keillu eno veeno chashub kelum, vahare hu keapar ukedabar sheen bo tzorek kelal. Ukesheggomer belibbo kak, hare hissiach dato mikkol chametz shebbirshuto venaasa hepqer gamur, veshub eno ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", kemo shennitbaer leel besiman tl"a. Umikkol maqom tiqqenu chakamim sheyyotzi debarim hallalu bepiv. Veyomar. "Kol chamira deikka birshuti dela chaziteh udela biarteh libbatel veleheve keapra deara". (Perush, lepi shehazzahab niqra gam ken apar shenneemar "veaprot zahab lo", kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman k"ch, lekak tzarik leparesh apra deara). Veap al pi shemmi sherotzeh lehapqir nekasayv veamar hare nekasay keapar en zeh kelum mikkol maqom kevan shezzeh hechametz beshaa sheober alayv be"bal yeraeh" eno shello kelal veen lo shum cheleq uzekut bo shehare asur lo lehanot mimmennu ella shehakkatub asao keshello sheyyehe shemo niqra alayv sheyyaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" ub"bal yimmatze" lepikak en tzarik lehapqiro bilshon hepqer gamur ella keshehu massiach dato umebattel belibbo umechashshebo keapar dayyo bekak lehapqia shemo mealayv shello yehe niqra shello velo yaabor alayv kelum. Umikkol maqom kol medaqdeq bemaasayv yeparet beperush habbittul bilshon arammi leshon hepqer gamur veyomar leheve hepqer keapra deara:

Velamma nitqan (d) nosach habbittul bilshon arammi? Mippene amme haaretz sheenam mebinim bilshon haqqodesh ki im bilshon arammi. Lepikak, baaratzot hallalu sheen amme haaretz mebinim gam leshon arammi, tzarik lelammedam ulehazhiram sheyyomru nosach habbittul belashon shehem mebinim, shehare iqqar habbittul hu balleb, lepikak tzarik lehabin balleb mah shehu motzi bispatayv. Veim abar veamar habbittul belashon sheeno mebino kelal, im hu yodea kavvanat habbittul, shekkavvanato hu lebattel hechametz ulehapqiro, ap al pi sheeno mebin perush hammillot shehu motzi bispatayv — yatza yede chobato. Abal otan amme haaretz veken nashim sheenan yodeim kelal inyan habbittul vekavvanato, venidmeh beenehem shehem omerim ezeh techinna ubaqqasha, ap al pi sheamaruhu bilshon arammi o bilshon haqqodesh — lo yatzeu yede chobatan, shehare iqqar habbittul vehahepqer hu balleb, sheim eno mapqiro belibbo ap al pi shehu omer shemmapqiro — en zeh kelum, shekkol hepqer tzarik lihyot piv velibbo shavin:

Kesheomer habbittul bilshon haqqodesh — tzarik lehazkir chametz useor, sheyyomar "kol chametz useor sheyyesh birshuti ku'", shehare al shenehem oberim be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" im lo bittelam, shenneemar "velo yeraeh leka chametz velo yeraeh leka seor vego'". Vehu haddin keshemmebattel bishar leshonot yazkir shenehem beperush. Abal keshemmebattel bilshon arammi en tzarik lehazkir, ki "chamira" kolel chametz useor, sheap hechametz niqra "chamira" lipamim. Umikkol maqom rauy lekol medaqdeq bemaasayv shello yismok al zeh veyazkir shenehem beperush ap shemmebattel bilshon arammi, sheyyomar "kol chamira vachamia deikka veku'":

Keshemmebattel hechametz belel y"d miyyad achar habbediqa — eno mebattel ella hechametz sheeno yadua lo shello metzao babbediqa, abal chametz hayyadua lo sheddato leekol mimmennu ballayla ulemachar ad shaa h' — ap im bittelo eno mebuttal, sheiqqar habbittul hu balleb, sheyyassiach dato mimmennu legamre, vechametz zeh sheshshiyyer lemaakalo hare libbo vedato alayv leekol mimmennu veeno mupqar etzlo:

Ulepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma nitgalgel kezayit mechametz zeh sheakal mimmennu ad shaa h' venapal leechad min hachorim o leachat min hazzaviyyot, ukesheyyaggia happesach yimtzaennu veyaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" (im yishheh meat qodem sheyyitasseq bebiuro, shekkezayit eno domeh leperurin [shebbetelim mealehem] lepi sheenan chashubim, abal kezayit chashub hu veeno batel meelayv). Lepikak, nakon haddabar shebbeshaa shehu mebaer min beto et hechametz sheshshiyyer lemaakalo — yachazor vibattel paam shenit kol chametz sheyyesh birshuto, kede sheyyebuttal gam ken hechametz shennitgalgel mechametz zeh sheshshiyyero lemaakalo, velo yaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" kesheyyimtzaennu bepesach:

Vekevan shehu tzarik lebattel bishat habbiur (mittaam shennitbaer), tzarik hu lizzaher ulebaer qodem shettaggia shaa shishshit, shemmittechillat shaa shishshit vaelak en beyado lebattelo, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g. Ubebittul zeh shebbishat habbiur yomar "kol chamira deikka birshuti dachaziteh udela chaziteh debiarteh udela biarteh veku'", shehare mebattel hakkol veeno meshayyer kelum leatzmo, mah sheen ken bebittul hallayla sheen dato lebattel ella hechametz shello raa velo matza babbediqa, lekak hu omer "dela chaziteh udela biarteh":

Veen leadam lismok al bittul zeh bilbad shello yebattel ballayla miyyad achar habbediqa, lepi shebbittul zeh shelleachar habbediqa hu taqqanat chakme haggemara, shettiqqenuhu miyyad leachar habbediqa kede sheyyihyeh lo zeman qabua, sheim lo haya lo zeman qabua haya nishkach milleb bene adam haalulin leshikcha. Velo ratzu liqboa zemanno bishat habbiur, lepi sheshsheat habbiur meiqqar haddin hu bitchillat shaa shishshit, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"h, veaz eno yakol lebattelo. Velo ratzu liqboa beyom y"d qodem sheat habbiur, dekevan sheen haadam oseq az bebiur chametz velo bibdiqato, yesh lachosh shemma yishkach lebattel, sheal yede mah yizkor? Abal ballayla sheoseq babbediqa yizkor gam ken lebattelo. Ubebittul zeh bilbad hu yotze yede chobato, veen tzarik lachazor ulebattel paam b' bayyom meiqqar haddin, shemmin haddin en lachosh shemma nitgalgel kezayit mechametz sheshshiyyero lemaakalo, shehechametz hamshuyyar laakila matzniin oto bemaqom meshummar, venizharin bo shello yitgalgel mimmennu kelum, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veakshav bedorot acharonim shennahagu lehachamir ulebaer chametz besop shaa h' ulebattelo bishat habbiur, lo bau ella lehosip al taqqanat chakamim velo ligroa, shehare im lo yebattel miyyad leachar bediqa yesh lachosh shemma yishkach millebaer hechametz ad shettaggia shaa shishshit, veaz eno yakol lebattelo:

Tob lizzaher shello lebattel hechametz paam b' bayyom ad sheyyebaer techilla min beto kol hechametz hayyadua lo, kede sheyyeqayyem mitzvat biur chametz bechametz shello, shelleachar habbittul en hechametz shello, shehare bittelo vehipqiro:

Yesh omerim shebben bebittul hallayla uben bebittul hayyom eno yakol laasot shaliach sheyyebattel chametzo, ella yebattel beatzmo, shehare haomer lachabero "tze vehapqer nekasay" — en bekak kelum, ad sheyyapqirem hu beatzmo. Veyesh omerim shehabbittul en tzarik lihyot domeh mammash lehepqer bedabar zeh, shehare hechametz beshaa sheober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" eno shello kelal, ella shehakkatub asao keshello, sheyyihyeh shemo niqra alayv sheyyaabor alayv, lepikak, begilluy daat bilbad shehu megalleh dato apillu al yede shaliach sheeno chapetz bo kelal — day bekak lehapqia shemo mealayv shello yaabor alayv. Veken iqqar. Veap al pi ken tob lachosh lekattechilla lassebara harishona:

Appoteroppos shel yetomim chayyab libdoq ulebattel chametz shel yetomim, kemo shehu chayyab laasot lahem kol sheare mitzvot, ben shel tora ben middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman r"tz.
